home.aboutTitle: Empowering dairy farming with Artificial Intelligence.
home.aboutIntro: Gomitra AI is an AI-powered platform that helps identify cow breeds from images. Our goal is to provide farmers, buyers, veterinarians, and researchers with an easy and reliable way to verify cattle breeds using deep learning technology.
home.storyP1: Karnataka is one of India's leading dairy-producing states, contributing significantly to milk and dairy products. However, many buyers and farmers face challenges in identifying the actual breed of cattle, which can lead to financial losses and fraudulent sales.
home.storyP2: Gomitra AI was created to help solve this problem by using Artificial Intelligence to identify cow breeds from images. Our platform aims to provide accurate breed predictions, helping users make informed decisions and reducing the chances of fraud in cattle trading.
home.missionBody: To make cow breed identification simple, accurate, and accessible through Artificial Intelligence, helping farmers and buyers make better decisions with confidence.
home.visionBody: To become a trusted AI platform that supports transparent cattle trading, promotes indigenous breed awareness, and contributes to the growth of smart dairy farming.
home.whyBody: Gomitra AI was developed to address a real-world problem in the livestock industry. By combining Artificial Intelligence with image recognition, our platform helps users verify cattle breeds quickly and accurately.
home.highlight2: Reducing fraud during cattle buying and selling
home.highlight4: Promoting awareness of indigenous and dairy breeds
home.highlight5: Providing an easy-to-use platform for farmers, veterinarians, and researchers
home.highlight6: Making breed identification faster, more reliable, and accessible
